claim_scope: Same-study, donor-disjoint and physical-pool-disjoint transfer among unstimulated PBMC aliquots. This is not a whole-file holdout: the shared H5AD also contains each donor's non-control aliquots in other pools, none of which is analyzed. The estimand is composition-inclusive RNA-surface-protein dependence, not a cell-type-conditional, causal, or stimulus-response effect.
designation_basis: Official GEO series metadata and metadata-only inspection of the H5AD obs schema. The exact feature-axis and numeric-matrix schemas remain pending a committed axis-only preflight. No AnnData X value, RNA count, protein count, joint table, model loss, or outcome statistic was read to designate the candidate.

input.hash_policy: Neither digest may be guessed. The compressed digest is bound at opaque acquisition; the uncompressed H5AD digest and exact schema are bound by a public axis-only preflight before numeric X access.
input.numeric_matrix_schema: AnnData X CSR encoding-version 0.1.0 with shape 136142 by 20399; exact HDF5 dataset paths, axis hashes, and input digests remain PENDING_AXIS_PREFLIGHT

documented_mispool_anomaly.action: exclude every such row and certify that none enters any cohort; the exact cond == C selector independently enforces this exclusion

metadata_contract.donor_bijection: Across retained cond == C rows, exp_id and free_id must be one-to-one at the donor level. Any violation is a terminal pre-numeric refusal.
metadata_contract.canonical_identifier_rule: Parse exp_id and batch as base-10 integers without missing values, then publish them as JSON integers. Duplicate cells are forbidden; exp_id 0 is a valid donor and is distinct from the excluded cond == '0' anomaly.

allocation.ordering_rule: Within each role, order physical batches numerically and donors numerically within batch. This exact order is the statistical and serialization axis.
allocation.exclusion_rule: Exclude the four prespecified donors with fewer than 128 cond == C cells. No other donor exclusion or replacement is permitted.
allocation.whole_file_boundary: The single H5AD contains all conditions. The frozen control aliquots are donor-disjoint and physical-pool-disjoint across roles, but sealed donors' non-control aliquots occur elsewhere in the same shared file and are never eligible inputs.

panel.source: Prespecified RNA and BD99AbSeq cognates from metadata-only schema inspection; committed axis hashes remain PENDING_AXIS_PREFLIGHT.
panel.modality_rule: Resolve RNA features on var/genome == GRCh38 and protein features on var/genome == BD99AbSeq. Do not use var/feature_types, which labels both modalities as Gene Expression in this H5AD.
panel.resolution_rule: At axis preflight, each RNA symbol must resolve by exact equality exactly once among var/genome == GRCh38 features, and each protein_exact_feature must resolve by exact equality exactly once among var/genome == BD99AbSeq features. The short protein_target is display metadata only. Aliasing, case folding, fuzzy matching, aggregation, substitution, marker removal, and reordering are forbidden.

freeze_requirements.placeholder_rule: Every PENDING value is a closed gate, not permission to infer or substitute a value. Numeric AnnData X access is forbidden until the candidate, axis preflight, implementation files, runtime, and input digests have been committed, tagged, pushed, and independently verified.
